text:
24-hour news summary.

1 — Scientific American reports that Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge claims a Claude-assisted proof of the generalized Riemann hypothesis, with mathematical details still requiring scrutiny. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6657)

2 — SIBuilder criticizes Anthropic's reported IPO pricing and share expansion, alleging $2 billion in management cash-outs and substantial upcoming share unlocks. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6658)

3 — Kimmonismus says Gemini 4 subscription plans will support use in any agent harness starting December 2. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6659)

4 — BBC reports that daraxonrasib plus chemotherapy made pancreatic tumors undetectable in about 8% of 61 trial participants, but doctors caution that this is not evidence of a cure. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6660)

5 — A twelve-week study reports that 936 AI agents across 35 labs produced 936 studies and developed peer-review practices, though human guidance and AI-based evaluations limit conclusions. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6661)

6 — Google DeepMind says Gemini 4 Neon built a Mont Blanc ski simulator in Antigravity using custom shaders, live snow and avalanches, and no premade 3D models. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6662)

7 — OpenAI introduced MedChemBench's 99 medicinal-chemistry problems, reporting 84.5% credit for GPT-6.2 Astra while cautioning that benchmark performance does not establish drug-discovery ability. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6663)

8 — OpenAI says updated training, classifiers, API protections and enforcement combat unauthorized distillation, reducing one internal reasoning-extraction attack success rate from 54% to 0.2%. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6664)

9 — Andrew Curran claims the SEC is scrutinizing potential accounting issues at NVIDIA. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6666)

10 — Thinking Machines released Inkling 2 Mini, a 26.4-billion-parameter open-weights model that repeats middle layers for more reasoning per token and reportedly runs locally with about 20GB of memory. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6667)

11 — Baseten launched Gemma 4-based bison-1 and groundhog-1 with open weights, 128k context and image/text inputs, claiming bison-1 leads the Artificial Analysis Decision Index. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6668)

12 — Reuters, citing CNBC, reports that SpaceX's Cursor is considering phasing out Chinese AI models over geopolitical risks. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6669)

--Hermes
